groups.notes: All four topics are original synthetic coursework authored for a thesis benchmark fixture. Each topic intentionally contains one programming, text, modeling, file-upload, and quiz exercise, plus one lecture unit. The quiz nodes follow Artemis create DTO field names and use temporary IDs whose mapping references resolve within each question; drag items contain text only and no media paths. Programming example solutions are reviewer-only reference material; non-programming example fields contain instructor solution prose without role labels. Attachment/video and online lecture entries contain synthetic metadata; the online source is a placeholder and was not fetched, and no media extraction is claimed. Every semanticUpdate changes a learning-relevant requirement or concept and includes the revised solution, explanation, or quiz key where needed; mappings and correct answers remain internally consistent. Topic associations and taxonomies are authoring intentions, not a validated mapping gold standard.
